job_description:
Job Title: Sr. BI & Data Analyst

Location: Canada, Remote

Job Description:

About the Job: At Charles River Laboratories, we’re transforming how we work by harnessing the power of AI, data, and digital innovation to accelerate the discovery and development of life-saving therapies. Our vision is to embed artificial intelligence and advanced analytics across every stage of our scientific and operational workflows—empowering our teams with smarter tools, seamless data, and actionable insights to deliver client-centric services and solutions that better serve our customers and, ultimately, improve patients’ lives.

As a Senior BI & Data Analyst, you’ll be a key driver of insight and innovation within our Enterprise Data and Analytics team. We’re looking for a curious, detail-oriented professional who thrives on turning complex scientific and operational data into clear, actionable intelligence. In this role, you’ll lead the development of analytical solutions that illuminate critical KPIs, uncover performance trends, and support strategic decision-making across the business. You’ll partner closely with stakeholders to map business processes, align data solutions with real-world operations, and conduct deep-dive analyses that solve high-value challenges. This is a high-impact opportunity to shape how data informs strategy and contributes to our mission of creating healthier lives.

As a Sr. BI & Data Analyst you will be focused on: Our team thrives on curiosity, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence. We work closely with cross-functional engineering and business partners to deliver impactful data and analytics solutions that shape the future of research and development.

Primary responsibilities include:
• Analyzing complex scientific datasets to uncover meaningful insights and support strategic initiatives.
• Mapping key business process rules to ensure data solutions align with operational realities.
• Creating insight-driven solutions that bring visibility into critical KPIs and performance metrics.
• Conducting deep-dive analyses to solve challenging problems and support evidence-based recommendations.
• Engage Business Stakeholders at all levels to identify requirements for current and future products through ongoing interaction.
• Lead requirements workshops and User Acceptance Testing for new data, products and analytics solutions.
• Analyze business processes and develop business flow diagrams and data flow diagrams to support system design and optimization.
• Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and business teams to ensure alignment and successful delivery.
• Data Profiling, mining, and data validation/testing to ensure data is fit for use by the business.
• Perform ad-hoc analysis and present results in a clear and user-friendly manner.
• Build strong business relationships that foster a collaborative and trusting approach and partnership.

Key Elements

Minimum qualifications for this role:
• Bachelor degree in Business Management, Computer Science or any related field.
• Master in Business Administration/ Information Systems/ Computer Science is an asset.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to approach challenges creatively.
• Ability to understand and make sense of complex datasets with a strong attention to detail
• Ability to translate requirements to well-written user stories to bridge the gap between business and technology.
• Strong business mindset with ability to collaborate with business partners to identify needs and opportunities for improved data management and delivery.
• Ability to see big picture and then identify key areas for deep analysis to support sound solutions.
• Self-driven and capable of working both independently and collaboratively within a team setting.
• Experience in life science or Biotechnology industry is a plus.

Technical Expertise required:
• Minimum of 5 years’ experience in writing complex SQL queries, data mining, data profiling, and data validation/testing;
• Minimum of 5 years’ experience as a Business Systems Analyst / Data Analyst specializing in the Data & Analytics discipline, preferably in a senior or lead role;
• Minimum of 5 years’ experience organizing and running User Acceptance Testing cycles and training with business users and stakeholders;
• Experience working with Data Visualization Tools like Power BI, Tableau, Looker, MicroStrategy

Experienced working in Agile Software Development Methodology

Business Information Management Analyst

Duration :
This is a 12 month contract located in Toronto/Ontario, Hybrid (3 days onsite).

Job Description

Global Operations & Business Services Overview:
Global Operations and Business Services employees are outstanding individuals whose varied talents and experience bring value to the way they deliver for the firm. Whether you are analytical or creative, business savvy or a people person, Global Operations and Business Services provide an ideal opportunity to succeed.

The Global Operations and Business Services team is a diverse and dynamic group of individuals delivering continued business success through leadership, collaboration, innovation and forward-thinking. We provide critical infrastructure services that support and/or control the trading, investment, and corporate banking functions of client Securities.

Within our core values, we champion a culture of diversity, inclusion and community support/giving.

Department Overview:

Our team believes the Bank of the future will be driven by customer centricity. By understanding and meeting the needs of our customer, client Securities will set itself apart as the Bank that truly "thinks customer".
The Data

Strategy team is accountable for executing and delivering data objectives against key strategic and regulatory initiatives for the client’s Party and Account Master platform. This is a data centric initiative to provide a comprehensive, accurate & consistent view of the Legal Entities within client’s.
We are a diverse and talented team that provides an integral core function to the business and your role is a key part of our success. By understanding the needs of our business partners, our purpose is to deliver complete and accurate data integrity.

In Data Strategy we live client’s Shared Commitments; we execute with speed and impact, innovate with purpose, act like an owner, think like a customer and develop our colleagues.

Job Description:

Are you a data-driven professional who thrives in a dynamic, evolving environment and can operate with ownership and strategic impact? As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a critical role in advancing enterprise data quality, supporting regulatory and strategic initiatives, and driving scalable data solutions across the client Party & Account Master platform.
Successful candidates will demonstrate strong analytical depth, stakeholder influence, and the ability to translate business needs into data-driven solutions while maintaining a strong risk and control mindset.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead complex data remediation and analysis initiatives across large, structured and unstructured datasets to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with enterprise data standards

• Drive data quality (DQ) improvements and control frameworks, proactively identifying data risks and implementing sustainable solutions to mitigate operational, regulatory, and reputational impacts

• Partner with business, technology, and data stakeholders to understand requirements, influence data strategy decisions, and deliver scalable data solutions aligned with business objectives

• Design and implement automation and process optimization solutions (e.g., Python, SQL, workflow tools) to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance control effectiveness

• Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for Party & Account data domains, providing guidance, resolving complex data issues, and supporting onboarding of new data consumers

• Translate business requirements into actionable data logic and rules, ensuring alignment with governance standards and downstream data consumption needs

• Support and lead project delivery efforts, including prioritization, execution, and tracking of data initiatives across multiple concurrent workstreams

• Produce insights and reporting to inform decision-making, highlighting key trends, risks, and opportunities to senior stakeholders

• Foster strong working relationships across client, influencing stakeholders and enabling effective collaboration across Operations, Technology, and CDO teams

• Mentor and support junior team members, promoting knowledge sharing, best practices, and a high-performance culture

• Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement, aligned with client’s Shared Commitments

Must have requirements:

• Strong understanding of capital markets and client/reference data domains, including corporate structures and industry data sources (e.g., Bloomberg, GLEIF)

• Advanced technical expertise in data analysis and remediation, leveraging tools such as SQL (Dremio), Python, Databricks, and Excel

• Proven ability to work with large-scale datasets, identify data quality issues, and implement scalable remediation solutions

• Strong business acumen and strategic thinking, with the ability to connect data initiatives to business outcomes and risk mitigation

• Experience working in data governance, data quality, or master data management environments

• Demonstrated ability to lead initiatives and influence stakeholders across multiple functions without direct authority

• Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues

• Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Highly developed communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex data concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Self-starter with a high degree of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail

Nice to have:

• Operations experience

• Project management/scrum experience

TekStaff may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools as part of the applicant screening process. However, applications will also be reviewed by a member of our Recruitment team to ensure a fair and thorough assessment.

job_title: Climate Reporting Analyst Intern, Environment, Social & Governance
job_description:
Concert Properties LTD is seeking a Climate Reporting Analyst Intern to support their Environment, Social & Governance (ESG) initiatives in Vancouver, BC. The intern will assist in climate reporting operations, data management, and process documentation to ensure accurate sustainability reporting. This role involves collaboration with the ESG and Digital Technology teams, focusing on data validation and reporting workflows in preparation for the 2027 reporting cycle.
About Concert Properties

Putting people first is at the heart of the Concert Properties story. We are deeply invested in improving the lives of the people who live and work in our communities, acknowledging that communities are more than just buildings. We focus on quality, consistency and sustainability, and our business is driven by warm, passionate people who embody a desire to help each of us feel more connected to one another.

We develop, own and manage rental apartments; develop condominium homes; and develop, acquire and manage industrial and office properties. Since 1989, we’ve grown to over $6.6 billion in assets under control.

Position Summary

At Concert Properties, our social purpose guides everything we do. We exist to create resilient, inclusive, and sustainable communities — which means we are harnessing our entire business model to drive positive impact for people and the planet. Through our ESG Strategy and Three-Year Plan, we tackle industry-wide challenges with innovative solutions and partnerships, ensuring our actions benefit both current and future generations. The Climate Reporting Analyst Intern would support advancing our purpose by strengthening the systems, processes and data foundations that enable accurate, consistent and assurance-ready climate and sustainability reporting. This internship offers hands-on experience in climate reporting operations, carbon data management, software implementation, process documentation and assurance preparation within a real estate context.

Reporting to the Manager, Environmental Sustainability, this role will work closely with the ESG team and Digital Technology to document reporting processes, support the transition of historical Scope 1 and 2 energy, emissions and water data into our new software system, and help test reporting workflows ahead of the 2027 reporting cycle.

About Concert Properties Key Responsibilities

The Climate Reporting Analyst Intern will support the ESG team by:

Developing and documenting standard operating procedures for climate reporting, building practical experience in process mapping, reporting controls, data governance and quality assurance.
Working with the Manager, Environmental Sustainability to map key reporting workflows, roles, responsibilities, timelines, controls and review points.
Supporting the upload, organization and validation of historical utility, energy, emissions and related sustainability data into our new software platform.
Coordinating with Digital Technology and ESG team members to identify data gaps, resolve inconsistencies and confirm that historical records are accurately reflected in the new system.
Testing reporting processes and system outputs to support third-party assurance readiness ahead of the 2027 reporting season, including issue identification, evidence preparation and recommended improvements.
Preparing clear documentation, summaries and status updates to support effective handover and ongoing process improvement.
What You’ll Gain:

Hands-on experience with climate reporting in the real estate sector, including Scope 1 and 2 energy, emissions and water data.
Practical exposure to carbon accounting, sustainability data systems and greenhouse gas reporting controls.
Experience documenting standard operating procedures and improving reporting workflows within a large organization.
Exposure to assurance readiness, including data testing, issue identification and evidence preparation.
Opportunities to work with ESG, Digital Technology and decarbonization professionals on reporting processes that support enterprise-wide climate strategy.
Required Knowledge & Skills

Demonstrated interest in sustainability, greenhouse gas emissions management, and the role of business in creating positive social and environmental impact.
Familiarity with, or interest in developing practical experience with, energy and emissions standards and disclosure protocols, including the GHG Protocol.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required, with experience using common computer software such as Microsoft Word and PowerPoint considered an asset.
Excellent verbal communication skills, interpersonal skills and presentation skills.
Strong attention to detail, with a commitment to producing high quality work, including thorough self-review.
Strong team player, with willingness to assist others as needed.
Curious and enthusiastic, with a desire and aptitude to grow professionally within a supportive environment.
This is a general description of the tasks and skills required. Additional responsibilities and duties may be required to successfully perform this position.

Join the Concert Properties team in building a people-first future.

Concert Properties is proud to have been named a BC Top Employer from 2021-2025!

We are a proud Canadian company, providing quality employment across the country and working together with the people we serve to realize our vision—building resilient, inclusive and sustainable communities. Our success is powered by a passionate, talented team that values a collaborative culture, a desire for excellence and a willingness to give back. We support our team members and offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits and perk programs that promote employee health and wellness.

At Concert Properties, we value diversity, equity and inclusion and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. We welcome applications from all qualified job seekers. The posted salary range is reflective of the qualifications and experience we are looking for in a candidate to fill this opportunity; however, applicants with all levels of experience are welcome to apply. Please be advised that only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

Thank you for your interest in Concert Properties.

Term, Compensation and Location:

Applications are due August 7, 2026.
This four-month full-time internship will run from September 8 to December 18, 2026.
Compensation is based on the living wage in British Columbia: $27.85 per hour.
This role is based out of the Concert Properties Vancouver office.
